messages:
laura: Kicking off a staged enable for feature flag `model-fastpath` tonight 23:00 UTC -> target 20% (10% internal beta, 10% external cohort). Need ops_oncall sign-off and rollback criteria. 

deploybot: preflight checks: configs OK, infra capacity OK, canary run passed (p95 latency +2ms). No blocked dependencies. :white_check_mark:

sam: Quick ask — pin serving version to `inference-v2.3.1` for the cohort. Recent auto-roll to v2.4 caused perf variance last week. If we don't pin we should at least fallback pin policy.

kai: +1 on pin. Also can we gate the first 10% behind the internal beta cohort only for 30m before opening external cohort? Need to validate top-end latency and tail error.

laura: plan: 23:00 enable internal beta -> 23:30 check telemetry -> 23:45 enable external 10% -> 00:15 validate -> 00:30 ramp to 20% if stable. Rollback trigger: error-rate > 3% or 5% degradation in correctness on eval set or p95 latency +50ms sustained for 10m.

marta: please update release notes with the rollout matrix and the pin decision. Also include the user-visible change (slightly faster completions, potential minor wording drift). I'll add a blurb under Release Notes > Inference features.

ops_oncall: I can cover the window. For rollback, is there a one-click kill switch? If so share the command and I'll keep it handy.

laura: yes one-click off via ops CLI and API. Example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood.ai/flags/toggle 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"flag":"model-fastpath","action":"disable","reason":"rollback"}'
```
Alternative (CLI): `redwoodctl flags set model-fastpath off --env prod --reason rollback`

deploybot: deploybot note: when toggled off, sessions currently using KV-cache may still finish requests until TTL expiry (~45s). Full effect within ~60s. Also auto-batch tuning will be reverted to baseline.

sam: put this in the emergency playbook: pinned version rollback steps + who to page.

laura: added to thread: @ops_oncall you will be primary pager for 23:00-01:00 UTC. sam you own pin enforcement. kai you own telemetry gate and will post the first 30m signal. marta will publish release note snippet before 22:30.

kai: I'll post a short checklist 15m before kick — will subscribe to `telemetry:inference` alerts and post metrics: error-rate, p50/p95/p99, token-cost delta. If anything looks off I'll flag for immediate rollback.

ops_oncall: ack, I've tested the kill command in staging. Keeping my terminal open and `tail -f /var/log/flags` during window. :thumbsup:

laura: one more: please ensure rollout uses cohort sticky pin so users in beta stay consistent across sessions. Use cohort key `user.is_beta == true`.

deploybot: rollout config snippet (JSON): 
```json
{"flag":"model-fastpath","strategy":"cohort","cohorts":[{"name":"internal-beta","percent":10,"selector":"user.is_beta == true"},{"name":"external-sample","percent":10}] ,"pin_version":"inference-v2.3.1"}
```

sam: looks good. If we see oscillation in load, auto-throttle the external cohort back to 0% and keep internal at 10%.

laura: final call: proceeding with preflight at 22:45, release window 23:00-02:00 UTC. If no objections in 15m I'll start the enable at 23:00.

marta: no objections from PM side. I'll merge the release note and link it here when done.

kai: noted. Will post telemetry snapshot at +30m and +60m.

ops_oncall: ready on my side.

laura: thanks all — posting a quick ops checklist in the runbook and will link here once created. :rocket:
